invariants.rationale: The method always constructs a HoodieWriteMetadata object to return; returning null is unlikely based on its body.
The returned value is always an instance of HoodieWriteMetadata due to the construction in the return statement.
transformedWriteStatuses is a List<WriteStatus> and is passed to clone, so result.getWriteStatuses() will be a List.
transformedWriteStatuses is always initialized from a non-null collectAsList on a valid writeMetadata, so result.getWriteStatuses() should not be null.
List.size() is always non-negative in Java.
